title: The Highland Cultivator (U Nongrep)
cultural_context: Published historical Khasi song from authentic literature, documenting ancestral culture, moral philosophy, and oral tradition.
lyrics_khasi:
Na ka step kynjat shai u nongrep u mih,
Da ka mohkhiew ha ka tyrpeng u leit sha lyngkha;
U trei da ka jingkmen ha ka shit ka kynriat,
Ban bsa ia la ka iing ka sem bad ka ri.

Ynda wan ka por ba thiew ia u kba,
Ka madan ka kylla ksiar lut baroh;
U nongrep u ainguh ia U Blei Nongthaw,
Namar ka jingai ba kordor jong ka mariang.
lyrics_english:
At the first glimmer of dawn the cultivator departs,
With his iron hoe upon his shoulder he journeys to the field;
He labors with delight in the scorching sun and cold rains,
To nourish his hearth, his clan, and his land.

When the season of rice reaping arrives,
The terraces turn entirely into radiant gold;
The cultivator offers thanksgiving to God the Creator,
For the bountiful harvest of Mother Nature.
